title: Rhythm section: Pattinson brothers and John Porter
summary: Albert lists early rhythm players, including the Pattinsons and bassist John Porter, who wouldn't leave New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Now, Cartrell, we know pretty well, we've got his life story now. So that's the reeds and the brass, the rhythm, Lloyd Glenn.
Well, there's some, a lot of them that you left out that came in later days. Yeah. But you're going to be the original, right?
Yeah, yeah, the main one. Right. I don't know. You had the Pattinson Brothers. Yeah.

From here. No, from Beaumont. Oh, yes. But you had Pattinson here that stayed in the start of John Pattinson. John Pattinson from here. He stayed in the short while. You know John Porter used to play the bass. Really?
He was with you from all of it. He didn't stay.
He didn't want to stay. He didn't want to leave New Orleans. It's funny, he was on the road so much, we showed. Right.
